caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic candlestick holder in the foreground, prominently rendered in shades of greenish-gold with areas of darker and lighter shading suggesting a reflective, shiny surface. The candlestick has a flared, rounded top for holding a candle, a narrow neck, a bulbous central section with faceted features, and a tiered, ringed mid-section that tapers downward to a wide, multi-stepped, octagonal base. The base sits flat on the surface, and each level is individually shaded to suggest depth and the play of light. To the left of the main colored illustration are two outline drawings: one is a profile view of the candlestick, and the other is a top-down view of its octagonal base, with a circular interior. Below these outlines, there is a small scale marked “INCHES.” The background is a plain, unshaded beige, and a fine double-banded rectangular border surrounds the entire drawing. In the lower right corner, the name “J. STALOFF” is inscribed.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
